name: openbb_fixedincome_iorb
description:
Interest rate on reserve balances (IORB, percent) from FRED through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.rate.iorb).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (accepted by the schema, ignored by this command); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fred only; schema default fmp (also rejected), but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
Market overnight rates: openbb_fixedincome_effr, openbb_fixedincome_sofr. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "fred"}
